name: fuel-gauge
description: Context and plan-limit meter: context fill, the 5-hour and weekly windows and session cost in the status line, a toast as a window crosses your thresholds, and /fuel for a pane with every running side session's context.

warnAt.title: Warn at (percent of a plan window)
warnAt.description: A toast when the 5-hour or weekly window crosses this, and again at the second threshold.

alarmAt.title: Second warning at (percent)
alarmAt.description: The second toast for a window.

contextWarnAt.title: Warn when context passes (percent)
contextWarnAt.description: A toast once when this session's context fill passes this.
